race.comment: YOU'RE THE CHOICE (6) her Maiden win came over this track and trip last January when leading throughout to score a dominant victory last January. Eye-catching return run when she launched from back in the field with a close-up second over 1200m at Canterbury. Can race a touch closer from the better gate and prove hard to stop. IVY DIVA (2) bounced back quickly with a fast-finishing victory over 1200m at Warren. Placed here three-back in this grade and not to be underestimated. EMERY (8) comes off a 47-day let-up after she resumed with a disappointing last over 1400m at Kembla Grange. Had excuses on that occasion and pulled yup with a poor post-race recovery. Worth another chance. RIVER PAT (13 will appreciate the firmer track after she faded in the heavy going to run sixth over 1262m at Taree in C3 class. Gets her chance from the good gate.
